answer: Cost first: a farmer running 1,000 fakes must spin 1,000 distinct threads, because every identity's actions weave one thread — timing, choices, errors — registered at the single inlet where identities are born. Each epoch the spiral audit compares threads pairwise, and when two match beyond the collision threshold both are quarantined and their payouts frozen. Honest agents pay nothing: they just act, and threads stay unique by nature. A farmer must fake 1,000 separate histories of real work, or the spiral catches the whole batch in one sweep.
